title: Great visit
text: Such a great tour! Isabel was so knowledgeable and had great stories with pictures from her phone.
author: AgnesQ558

title: class combined with originality.
text: It was a bit by chance that we decided to visit this palace, what a godsend. It was the last residence of the eccentric Duchess of Alba who died there about ten years ago. You get the feeling she just left because we visit the rooms where she lived, painted. The decoration is in his image, original and revealing of his passions but so touching. The patios and gardens are romantic.
author: Sherpa32442988315
